extra.reason: Decided 2026-09-16: product for others. Small scale initially but lightly scalable. Audience is not necessarily tech savvy, so editing UI must be polished and no file editing; needs auth and multi-user, multi-trip data model.

Decided 2026-09-16: general trip planner, no TDF-specific concepts in core. Core = days, places, lodging, transit, activities. Optional generic 'event anchor' (race, festival, wedding, conference) may be added later; race becomes one event type. Nothing race-specific in v1.

Decided 2026-09-16: agent proposes, user picks. App drafts days and open gaps; agent researches candidates (lodging, activities, transit) surfaced as friendly cards the user accepts/rejects/asks for more. Mirrors TDF research-inbox flow behind a simple non-technical UI, never raw JSON.

Decided 2026-09-16: Holly prefers Python and React, keep Vercel. Frontend: React + Vite + TS, React Router, Leaflet. Backend: FastAPI on Vercel Functions (Fluid Compute) via Vercel Services in one project. DB: Neon Postgres (Marketplace) with SQLModel/SQLAlchemy + Alembic. Auth: Clerk (React SDK + FastAPI JWT verification). Agent: Python Anthropic SDK via AI Gateway.
Decided 2026-09-16 (revised): Render instead of Vercel. React+Vite static site, FastAPI web service, Python background worker for the research agent, Render Postgres, Clerk auth. See description.
Data model drafted in docs/data-model.md and approved by Holly 2026-09-16 (date-range lodging, Gap as its own table, per-trip Places).
Inbox/candidate comparison UI specified in docs/prd.md section 5.5 (drawer over board, side-by-side cards, choose/reject/find more, rejected footer, no JSON/ids).

Scaffolded 2026-09-16: backend/ (FastAPI, SQLModel models from data-model.md, Clerk JWT auth, health/me/trips routes, worker loop with compare-and-set job claim, Alembic initial migration), web/ (Vite React TS, React Router, Clerk sign-in/up, trip list page), render.yaml (db + api + worker + static), README. Verified locally: migration applies to SQLite, /health and /health/db 200, /trips 401 without token, worker claims and completes a queued job, frontend builds. Not yet deployed: needs Render + Clerk accounts.
Fixed: certifi-backed ssl_context on PyJWKClient; verified JWKS keys fetch.

Trip cards show status, friendly date range, and open-gap count (open+researching). Start a trip -> /trips/new simple form (to be replaced by conversational intake in travelplanner-o4y) -> /trips/:id placeholder with delete. API: validation (blank title, backwards dates), open_gap_count on list/get, owner-only DELETE with child cleanup, 404 for non-members. 6 pytest tests pass; web build passes.

Conversational intake shipped: POST /intake/turn (stateless, client holds history + edited draft; Claude Opus 5 structured output, effort medium, server-side fallbacks default; max 2 follow-ups tracked via message kind), POST /intake/confirm (Trip, Days, city Places, lodging-per-stay and activity-per-day gaps), GET /trips/:id/days. Web: chat panel + skeleton editor on /trips/new, day list on trip page. 24 pytest tests; real-API check produced a sensible 10-day Portugal draft (~15s) and a follow-up question for a vague prompt. Browser click-through not yet done by Holly.

Planning board first cut: GET /trips/:id/board (days, places with locating flag, gaps with lodging night coverage and latest job, lodgings, activities), POST /gaps/:id/research (idempotent, member-only, 409 when filled). City geocoding via Nominatim: server-side, cached in geocode_cache, 1 req/s lock, identifying UA, failed lookups retry after 15 min; triggered on confirm and board load. Worker stub fails jobs with a plain message and reopens the gap. Web: /trips/:id board with Leaflet map (city pins, route line), day picker, Overview/Day/Where to stay/Things to do tabs, gap slots with Find options and polling. Deferred: layer toggles, edit drawer, Add it yourself (travelplanner-uaa). 36 pytest tests; real Nominatim end-to-end located Lisbon, Évora, Porto.

Live 2026-09-16. Web https://travelplanner-web.onrender.com, API https://travelplanner-api-vfwt.onrender.com. Fixed two issues during deploy: web built against predicted API URL (Render added -vfwt suffix) -> corrected VITE_API_URL and redeployed web; intake 400 because Render's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was not workspace-scoped -> replaced with a workspace-scoped key. Holly confirmed intake works in production. Custom domain (e.g. trips.hollyafrench.com) not yet set up.
Fixed; 36 tests pass on SQLite (FKs on) and Postgres.

API now rejects Clerk tokens whose azp names a site outside AUTHORIZED_PARTIES (defaults to CORS_ORIGINS, so no Render env change), matching Clerk's authorizedParties rule (azp checked when present). Also requires exp, iat, sub claims. 9 new tests sign real RS256 tokens with a local key: our origins pass, foreign azp/wrong issuer/expired/missing sub/wrong key get 401, plus an end-to-end /me check.

Research agent live: Opus 5 + web_search_20260318 + strict submit_candidates tool; sources verified against search result URLs (else Unverified/low); worker builds context (trip, nearby days, nudge, prior/rejected options), saves Candidate/Place/Source, records tokens/searches/cost, recovers stale jobs; board shows option cards with Find more. Tuned to 5 searches/low effort after measuring (~$0.33, ~47s per gap vs ~$0.85 at 8/medium). 62 tests on SQLite and Postgres; tests blocked from real API calls.

Fixed: geocoding no longer appends destinations as free text. Cities are looked up as featureType=settlement limited to the trip's country codes (resolved per destination, e.g. Scotland->gb), then settlement anywhere, then administrative areas within trip countries; only boundary/place results accepted, so shops/buildings/roads never match. Cache keyed by structured params and stores category/country_code. Migration clears old cache and resets city pins so trips re-geocode on next board load. Regression test for Edinburgh->Paris; migration verified on Postgres and SQLite; live Nominatim located Edinburgh, Leeds, London, Lille, Paris correctly and left Douro Valley unpinned.

Comparison drawer shipped. API: POST /candidates/{id}/choose (Lodging for exact stay nights or Activity on the day, status planned, link/price/place carried over; gap answered), /reject (optional reason) and /restore, POST /gaps/{id}/reopen (removes plan item, options back). Board returns hidden options, resolution ids, place details, plan item notes/links. Worker pins options via Nominatim address/name lookup kept only within 40 km of the day's base city. Web: drawer over the board panel (?gap=), side-by-side cards with Choose / Not this one + reason, Hidden (n) with Bring back, Find more with nudge, chosen stays/plans with Change on Day and Where to stay tabs, option and chosen pins on the map with hover/click linking. Research starts only from Find options/Find more buttons. Tests blocked from Nominatim; 78 pass on SQLite and Postgres; live pins for 3 Lisbon hotels within 1 km. Browser click-through not yet done.
scripts/agents.sh (landed in 100c03a via shared checkout) and Parallel Agents section in CLAUDE.md
ConfirmDialog component used for Change; build passes. Delete trip still uses window.confirm.

City fallback now requires trip countries or <=1500 km from trip's other pinned cities (cities pinned in trip order); area-in-countries tried before anywhere. Option and chosen places are retried through the shared locator (board background + worker), with a research map_query field and a leading-town settlement fallback for descriptive names (Clermont-Ferrand city centre..., Blois–Chambord loop...). Map uses a chosen pinned hotel as its base place's pin and in the route. Data migration clears cache, resets city pins, re-queues unpinned options. Regression tests for Central France->Brazil and Holly's Clermont stay; 83 tests on SQLite and Postgres.
Created .claude/agents/python-reviewer.md; available after session restart (new agents directory).

Merged PR #1 into master 2026-09-16 and deployed. Owner-only publish/regenerate/unpublish, public GET /share/{slug} with allow-listed payload (plan descriptions kept per Holly), noindex + no-store headers, mobile /s/:slug page with map and expandable days. 88 tests on SQLite and Postgres. Holly reviewed locally. Follow-up when #2 merges: order public plans by activities.time_of_day.

Merged PR #2 into master with share link and deployed 2026-09-16. Add a plan (Find ideas request research with day plans + chosen stay context, or Add it yourself with best-effort pin), time-of-day ordering, reorder, edit, remove (reopen vs delete), starter gap only counts while day empty, Add a plan is the single entry point for day plans. Python review found removed requests still ran paid research; fixed with cancel + worker backstop and tests. 101 tests on SQLite and Postgres; migration checked on Postgres.
Ruleset active and applies to master (verified via rules API).

Fixed and deployed 2026-09-17. next_sort_order now takes a time_of_day param and groups by it.
